seoTitle: Import Etsy & Temu Reviews to Shopify for Free
metaDescription: Bring genuine Etsy and Temu product reviews into your Shopify store for free using a review app, boosting trust and making listings look authentic.
intro: Real customer feedback from Etsy and Temu can make a new Shopify store look far more credible than empty product pages. This guide shows how to install a free review-import app, scan reviews directly from Etsy and Temu product pages, bulk import them, and customize how they display on your store.

steps.heading: Install the free review import app
steps.body: Add the app from the Shopify app store that supports pulling reviews from external marketplaces like Etsy and Temu.

steps.heading: Import reviews from Etsy product pages
steps.body: Point the app at the relevant Etsy listing so it can scan and pull in the existing customer reviews for that product.

steps.heading: Import reviews from Temu product pages
steps.body: Repeat the process for matching products on Temu, importing their reviews into your Shopify catalog as well.

steps.heading: Bulk import and edit reviews
steps.body: Use the bulk import option to save time across multiple products, then edit or curate the imported reviews as needed.

steps.heading: Customize how reviews display
steps.body: Adjust the review widget's appearance so imported feedback fits naturally with your store's design and theme.

faq.question: Is importing Etsy and Temu reviews really free?
faq.answer: Yes, this method uses a free Shopify app extension to scan and import reviews without any paid plan required.

faq.question: Will this work for a dropshipping store?
faq.answer: Yes, it's suited for both dropshipping stores and stores selling their own products, since the goal is simply to add social proof.

faq.question: Can I import reviews for many products at once?
faq.answer: Yes, the app supports bulk importing multiple reviews at a time rather than adding them one by one.

faq.question: Can I edit the imported reviews before they go live?
faq.answer: Yes, the process includes options to edit and customize reviews after they've been imported into your store.
